analysis: Batch 1.1 (G4) - laws 677 and 1313 at orders 8 and 10, left UNKNOWN by EXP-C05-03, decided by a complete case split (proofs/paper/C05.md Lemma 8: idempotent or not, cycle type of the row of an element with the fewest fixed points; 45 CNFs per law at n = 8, 97 at n = 10) with implied division clauses (Lemma 9) and, for 1313, Latin columns (Lemma 7, Lean). All 284 CNFs at n = 8 and 10 are UNSAT and every DRAT proof (40.5 million lines in total) was VERIFIED by drat-trim; 406 instances with the controls, 0 UNKNOWN, 0 rejected proofs. The controls reproduce EXP-C05-03 (models at 5 and 7, none at 6). Hardest case: 677, n = 10, non-idempotent, row 0 of type (6, 4) with 0 in the 4-cycle, 1.33 million conflicts. A first split on the cycle type of row 0 alone had left 41 of the 97 order-10 cases of 677 undecided at 300,000 conflicts, nearly all with 0 idempotent.
assumptions: rows are permutations for both laws (Lean: left_mul_bijective_of_law); columns are permutations for 1313 (proofs/paper/C05.md, Lemma 7)
the case split of proofs/paper/C05.md, Lemma 8 (idempotent / non-idempotent, cycle type of the row of an element with fewest fixed points) is complete
implied division clauses: for x = y*T, y*a = x forces T = a; for 677 (T = x*S) also x*a = T forces S = a; for 1313 (T = S*y) also a*y = T forces S = a
CaDiCaL 1.5.3 (pysat) with proof logging; the conflict budget per instance is fixed, an exhausted budget is reported UNKNOWN
drat-trim (github.com/marijnheule/drat-trim), found via DRAT_TRIM or the scratchpad build path
orders 5, 6, 7 are re-decided as a control (models known at 5 and 7, none at 6)
falsification: A verified model of order 8 or 10 refutes H-C05-G; a control order that disagrees with EXP-C05-03 (SAT at 5, 7; UNSAT at 6) or a proof drat-trim rejects would expose an error.

methodology: For each law and n in (5, 6, 7, 8, 10), enumerate the cases (idempotent, lam, 1) for the partitions lam of n with a part 1 and (non-idempotent, lam, ell) for every part ell >= 2 of every lam; build the CNF (law, Latin rows, Latin columns for 1313, row 0 = pi(lam, ell), fixed-point bounds, idempotency where applicable, division clauses); solve with CaDiCaL under a fixed conflict budget (2 worker processes); verify every UNSAT proof with drat-trim and every SAT table with the law.
